expert.text: Build AI governance programmes with dedicated staff and software, kept separate from security.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Keep one AI inventory with owners and risk classes, and label AI-generated content for EU users.
lens.ciso: Fold AI risks into existing controls; insurers increasingly ask for evidence of AI governance.
lens.cto: Classify AI systems by risk now; EU duties for high-risk systems start in December 2027.
lens.eng: Log model versions, data sources and decisions so AI systems can be audited later.

line: EU AI Act duties arrive in stages, and insurers and buyers now ask for AI controls too.
scope: AI rules, risk classes and oversight. Not content labels or cyber law.

sources.name: Gartner
sources.title: Top Strategic Predictions for 2027 and Beyond

title: AI governance
why: The AI Omnibus moved high-risk rules to Dec 2027 and Aug 2028.
Labels for AI-generated content apply since 2 August 2026.
Gartner expects insurers, not regulators, to set AI governance by 2030.
